main_text.l: ILLVSTRI HEROI, DN. FLORIANO GRIESPEC A GRIESPACH, DOMINO KATZERAVIAE, Rosenthallae & Florian­sburgi, aurato Bohemico Equiti, S. P. D.

M AGNANIME Domine FLORIANE, Quũ nulla vnquam ætas fuerit, quæ nõ subministrârit multa & tristia exempla veteris proverbij: Heroũ filiȷ noxæ: est enimuerò cur tibi gratulemur eximiam illam felicitatẽ, de qua dicitur Psalmo 112. Beatus est vir ille qui timet Iehouam, & mandatis eius delectatur multum. Potens in terra erit semen eius: progenies rectorum benedicetur.

Felix enim es, inclyte Domine, etiam generosi filij tui Domini BLASII, pietate & virtute: quam ita hoc tempore laudatissimæ BASILIENSIS Academiæ Antecessoribus probat, vt inter literatæ Nobilitatis litatis

page.notes: The woodcut initial M is an engraved historiated letter with a figure and trees; the first word is printed as "AGNANIME" with the M set as the woodcut. The final line "litatis" is the catchword repeated at the foot; the text ends on the line "Nobilitatis". Some words in the opening may be misprinted and are copied as printed.
